description.value: Zakkushi on Main is a Japanese yakitori izakaya that opened in 2008 as the second location of the Vancouver-based Zakkushi Group, skewering each item fresh over imported Bincho charcoal for authentic flavour. It occupies a booth-seating dining room on Vancouver's vibrant Main Street corridor and carries a rotating seasonal menu available exclusively at this location. Touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's east side will find it a well-established full-service restaurant with both dine-in and takeout options.
